description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling the top list view display for opportunities in the Opportunities module. It initializes a list view, constructs a query to filter non-closed opportunities assigned to the current user, and renders a top opportunities list with optional layout editing links for admins.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views within SuiteCRM. Handles query setup and display of list data.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the template for the list view with specified template file and language strings.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title of the list view, optionally appending edit layout link for admins.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the filtering conditions, limit, sorting order, and other query parameters for the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with the provided seed bean and display parameters.
